## Description {#details}

<p>Video sub-stream view into a texture.</p>


<p>Defines the view rectangle corners in pixels. End values are exclusive and can be smaller than start values to allow flips.</p>


<p>Definition at line 663 of file <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/files/qar-streaming-c/include/qar-streaming-h">qar_streaming.h</a>.</p>
